1.0.1.en: Added the network map: every device drawn as a star joined to the ones it relays through, the route each takes back to Homey, and a quality grade on every hop with the weakest links listed first.

1.1.0.en: Added fullscreen for the network map. On a phone held upright the map turns sideways, so turning the phone gives a wide view, and tapping a device shows its route to Homey in a panel beside the map.

1.1.1.en: Added webserver so the visualizer can be viewed in a browser. (unpublished)

1.2.0.en:
• Snapshot history: the app saves your Zigbee network on the clock, every 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours, keeping up to 24. It is off by default; switch it on with the gear in the history bar.
• Step back through the snapshots in the browser view; the map stays in place while you switch.
• New Changes tab: devices that switched parent, joined or left since the snapshot before, also marked on the map with a dashed ring.
• The history bar marks the snapshots in which routes changed.
• Every device shows its route history, with a warning when it keeps switching parents.
• Download button: saves every snapshot plus the live state as one JSON file, summarised and explained for analysis by an AI.
• Devices that report the same network address are now both shown, in the browser view and on the settings page.
• A Conflicts counter in the top bar points out devices that share a network address.
• The Browser button on the settings page is only shown on a computer.
